meta.note: Generated: edit jetons.json, check with tokens.mjs, export again.

tokens.name: color-surface-map
tokens.usage: Map and PAR background, the 'None (black)' base map.

tokens.name: color-surface-panel
tokens.usage: Panels: list, radio bar, aircraft card, settings; unchanged.

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, help bubbles, chips on a panel.

tokens.name: color-surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of a row or control; the darkest surface every text token must pass on.

tokens.name: color-surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, active tab, active filter: opaque green, so text contrast does not depend on what lies behind.

tokens.name: color-surface-urgent
tokens.usage: Background of an emergency line in the journal or the list.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, types, secondary values. 7.2:1 on hover.

tokens.name: color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Units, timestamps, hints. 4.7:1 on hover: the floor.

tokens.name: color-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only (exempt from WCAG contrast).

tokens.name: color-text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a filled accent button.

tokens.name: color-border-default
tokens.usage: Panel edges, the main separator; unchanged.

tokens.name: color-border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of an input, an unchecked box, an off toggle: at least 3:1 on panel, raised and hover (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: color-accent-default
tokens.usage: The tool's voice: brand, live, selected, focus. One green only (the #4ADE80 of the sign-in page goes).

tokens.name: color-accent-strong
tokens.usage: Accent text on the selected surface when more weight is needed (8.1:1 on panel).

tokens.name: color-status-urgent
tokens.usage: Emergency and failure, as text or icon; always with a shape or word.

tokens.name: color-status-urgent-fill
tokens.usage: Emergency badge (white text 6.5:1), always outlined with status.urgent (6.4:1 on panel), which detaches it from the panel. Darker than the accent so that a deuteranope tells them apart by lightness (ΔE 18).

tokens.name: color-status-warn
tokens.usage: Attention: degraded service, weak match, go-around, runway change.

tokens.name: color-status-info
tokens.usage: Neutral information that is not the tool's voice: help marker, link.

tokens.name: color-status-ok
tokens.usage: Status light 'ok' = the accent: a working chain is a live chain.

tokens.name: color-status-unknown
tokens.usage: Status light 'unknown' = tertiary text, hollow shape.

tokens.name: color-phase-cruise
tokens.usage: CRZ. Pale sky: high and passing.

tokens.name: color-phase-arrival
tokens.usage: ARR, APP, T/D. Blue: coming in.

tokens.name: color-phase-unknown
tokens.usage: NEW, UNK. Grey: nothing known yet.

tokens.name: color-altitude-dark-very-low
tokens.usage: Very low, near the ground: pale yellow, the most visible.

tokens.name: color-altitude-dark-cruise
tokens.usage: Cruise: slate, the quietest: the most numerous and the least relevant to a local listener.

tokens.name: color-altitude-light-very-low
tokens.usage: Very low on a light base map (IGN, OSM): dark olive, the most visible.

tokens.name: color-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a full page (settings) over the map: black at 70 %.

families.family-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: text-small
styles.usage: Dense prose: plain-language explanations, help bubbles, captions.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Air France quatre sept Kilo X-ray, autorisé ILS piste deux six gauche.
styles.usage: Transcriptions and anything read as a sentence.

styles.name: mono-caption
styles.usage: Times, frequencies in a header, units, badges, counters.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Table cells, a row's second line.

styles.name: mono-callsign
styles.usage: A callsign in a row or a chip.

styles.name: mono-display
styles.usage: The followed aircraft's callsign; the brand name.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels floating over the map, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Only for what floats over the map (popover, help bubble), where the base map may be bright. Nothing else casts a shadow: on black it does not show.

tokens.name: font-size-caption
tokens.usage: Floor. Units, field labels (upper case), timestamps, badges.

tokens.name: font-size-small
tokens.usage: Dense data: table cells, secondary lines of a row.

tokens.name: font-size-display
tokens.usage: Page title, the one big number of a card.

tokens.name: border-width-strong
tokens.usage: Focus ring, selected aircraft, active tab underline.

tokens.name: size-target-desk
tokens.usage: Minimal side of a pointer target on the desk.

tokens.name: size-target-touch
tokens.usage: Minimal side of a touch target on the phone.

tokens.name: size-row-desk
tokens.usage: Aircraft row in the list, desk: two lines (body 20 + caption 14) and 2 x 4 px padding, plus 2 px gap. Today about 50 px (12/10 captures).

tokens.name: size-row-touch
tokens.usage: Aircraft row in the list, phone: the whole row is the target.

tokens.name: size-control-desk
tokens.usage: Height of a button, toggle or segment on the desk.

tokens.name: size-control-touch
tokens.usage: Height of a control on the phone.

tokens.name: size-control-large
tokens.usage: A control that carries two texts: the search field, a channel button.

tokens.name: size-panel-head
tokens.usage: Header of a panel (title and quiet actions).

tokens.name: size-tabs-head
tokens.usage: Header of the context column: its two tabs and the fold button.

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: The top bar: the sign, what is on air, the lights, the clock.

tokens.name: motion-duration-alert-pulse
tokens.usage: Emergency only: three pulses, then steady.
